description: Remix is a cloud-based public transport planning platform, now sold by Via as Remix by Via. Planners design and edit fixed routes and on-demand zones on a map, evaluate trade-offs with predictive analytics, estimate running times with machine-learning tools, forecast ridership with a travel demand tool that uses real-world Citymapper data, and create GTFS feeds for riders and scheduling teams, all in presentation-ready maps shared across an agency. Via lists users such as Auckland Transport, King County in Seattle, which coordinated with 39 municipalities, and New York's MTA. Coverage: any agency network; separate cloud instances serve the United States, Europe, Australia and New Zealand and the rest of the world. Access: web application after a demo and contract. Licence and cost: proprietary and paid; prices are not published. Caveats: agency data and results sit inside the vendor platform, ridership forecasts depend on third-party data whose method is not published, and nothing can be downloaded without an account. It supports service planning, detour and disruption planning and equity analysis for transit networks, and complements the Conveyal Analysis platform and the GTFS specification catalogued here.
